commands.name: format
commands.description: f  Runs the configurable format pipeline on a directory.

commands.name: issues
commands.description: i  Lists open issues from GitHub.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: m  Squash-merges the current feature branch PR and cleans up.

commands.name: new
commands.description: n  Bootstraps a new repository from organization templates.

options.name: --type
options.description: (Requires: Object) -- Project type key from config (e.g., classlib, console, tool).

options.name: --name
options.description: (Requires: Object) -- Full project name (e.g., CalqFramework.Dev). Dot-separated.

options.name: --public
options.description: (Default: False) -- Create a public GitHub repository.

options.name: --private
options.description: (Default: False) -- Create a private GitHub repository.

options.name: --internal
options.description:
(Default: False) -- Create an internal GitHub repository (Enterprise only).
--organization -o  (Default: NULL) -- GitHub organization override. Falls back to config default.

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Pulls from remote with rebase, regardless of current branch.

commands.name: push
commands.description: Pushes to remote. Behavior differs on main vs feature branches.

commands.name: relock
commands.description: r  Forces re-evaluation of the dependency graph and updates lock files.

commands.name: switch
commands.description: s  Switches to or creates an issue branch.
